_comment: Global model levers, one section per AstraClass module. Per-class values live in Star_Data.json / Planet_Data.json; habitability scoring lives in Habitability_Data.json. Physical constants (G, Earth mass, AU, ...) stay in code.

stellar._comment_class_position_jitter: Per-property offset (fraction of the class range) from the shared class position, so stars at the same position are not identical. 0 = mass, radius and temperature perfectly locked together.
stellar._comment_galaxy_position_range: Each of X, Y, Z is a random integer in this range.
stellar._comment_soi: Sphere of influence (AU) = this x stellar mass (Mo).
stellar._comment_ice_line: Ice line (AU) = coefficient x sqrt(Lo). Zones below are multiples of the ice line.
stellar._comment_goldilocks: Goldilocks zone spans the distances where irradiance falls from max to min (W/m^2).

system._comment_body_count: Poisson lambda = class lambda x (1 + metallicity_multiplier x [Fe/H] clamped to +/- metallicity_clamp).
system._comment_giant_probability: Sigmoid in [Fe/H]: k x ([Fe/H] - x0), boosted by star_mass_boost per Mo above 1, capped at max.
system._comment_zone_distribution: Rocky and giant zone weights are each scaled by (1 + metallicity_boost x [Fe/H]).
system._comment_placement: Gladman (1993) spacing: bodies at least k mutual Hill radii apart, using a representative mass (Me) since real masses are not known yet.
system._comment_belts: Belt dwarf count is Poisson: base lambda x (1 + metallicity_boost x [Fe/H] clamped +/-1) x giant_shepherding (if any giant), clamped to lambda_range.

planetary._comment_rocky_mass: Rocky mass is log-normal: exp(gauss(ln(median), sigma)), then clamped to the Planet_Data rocky bounds.
planetary._comment_giant_mass: Giant mass = core + core x envelope_ratio, each drawn uniformly, then clamped to the Planet_Data giant bounds.
planetary._comment_mass_modifiers: Applied after the draw: metallicity factor max(floor, 1 + beta x [Fe/H]); star-mass factor 1 + boost x (Mo - 1, min 0); competition 1 / (1 + strength x (count - free_bodies, min 0)). sanity_range is the final clamp for non-giants.
planetary._comment_core: Core mass fraction (CMF) is log-normal around cmf_median, scaled by metallicity, zone and mass, then clamped. Core composition is Fe (gaussian) + Ni (uniform) + light elements (remainder).

core._comment_liquid: Liquid core fraction ~ Beta(alpha, beta); alpha rises and beta falls with core mass relative to Earth's core (reference_core_mass, clipped to proxy_clip).
core._comment_dynamo: Rocky dynamo = (base + slope x min(cap, log10(max(core mass, core_mass_floor)) + offset)) x spin factor. Giant dynamo ranges are in Planet_Data.

planetary._comment_giant_classifier: Giants between the Planet_Data mass bounds: P(gas giant) = sigmoid((M - midpoint) / width) + zone bias, capped at max. Zone bias = bias_max x (zone_reach - SMA / ice line), clamped to [0, bias_max] (ice line floored at ice_line_floor_au).

atmosphere._comment_gases: Order matters (escape draws happen in this order). zones = body types that can hold the gas (amounts come from geochemistry). condense = 1-atm boiling/frost point and latent heat, for Clausius-Clapeyron condensation caps (water is handled separately). dof = degrees of freedom (3 monatomic, 5 diatomic, 6 nonlinear, 7 CO2), sets the adiabat. ir_strength / ir_saturation_atm = infrared optical depth curve, see greenhouse.
atmosphere._comment_jeans: A gas is retained only if escape velocity >= jeans_factor x its thermal velocity.
atmosphere._comment_stellar_stripping: Inside sma_au, light gases (mol mass < light_gas_mol_mass) are stripped with chance max_chance x (1 - SMA / sma_au) x max(min_exposure, 1 - dynamo x dynamo_shielding).
atmosphere._comment_escape: Jeans escape is judged at the exosphere temperature: max(bare temperature, exosphere_K_at_earth x (irradiance / earth_irradiance)^exosphere_irradiance_exponent). Earth ~1000 K (loses H2, He); Titan ~100 K (keeps N2).
atmosphere._comment_composition: Giants: subclass gas_table_weights (Planet_Data) x giant_weight_jitter for H2/He; heavy species x 10^(giant_metallicity_exponent x [Fe/H] + N(0, giant_heavy_scatter_dex)). A second gas above secondary_gas_label_min is named in the atmosphere type. Gases below trace_floor are dropped from the output.
atmosphere._comment_geochemistry: Rocky worlds, dwarfs and moons: composition from volatile geochemistry (BodyGeochemistry / BodyGasComposition). Sources: N2 = N x nitrogen; carbon C x carbon x outgassing, split by mantle redox into CO2 (oxidised), CO and CH4 (reduced; CH4 when cool); H2 from water x hydrogen x reduced; sulfur S x sulfur x volcanism x tidal into SO2 / H2S by redox and pressure (Gaillard et al.); NH3 from N on reduced, cold worlds; trace abiotic O2. Sinks: weathering (CO2) and rainout (SO2, H2S, NH3) on liquid-water worlds, reduced gases destroyed in oxidising atmospheres (survival 10^(-reduced_gas_lifetime_dex x oxidised share); carbon goes to CO2, H2S to SO2), NH3 photolysis unless haze-shielded, condensation at each gas's frost point. Water vapour follows humidity at the surface temperature.

geochemistry._comment_c_to_o: Nissen 2014: C/O = 0.58 at solar [Fe/H], +0.3 per dex, rms 0.06. Above carbon_rich_above (Bond et al. 2010) the world is carbon-rich; carbon inventory x (C/O / solar)^carbon_exponent.
geochemistry._comment_redox: Mantle oxygen fugacity relative to the iron-wustite buffer (Earth ~ +3.5, Mars ~ +1, Mercury ~ -5). Outgassed carbon/hydrogen/sulfur is oxidised with weight 1 / (1 + exp(-(dIW - oxidised_mid_dIW) / oxidised_width_dIW)) (Ortenzi et al. 2020).
geochemistry._comment_pressure_per_unit_atm: Surface pressure follows the gas budget. Each source unit (Earth-like N2 = 1) is this many atm on Earth, scaled by mass x (g / 9.81) / radius^2 (same inventory per kg of planet) and by retention. Venus-like dry worlds keep their carbon as tens of atm of CO2; ocean worlds weather it away.
geochemistry._comment_retention: Share of the outgassed atmosphere still held: worlds with a strong dynamo (Thick class) 10^N(0, thick_sigma_dex); weak-dynamo worlds (Thin class) 10^uniform(thin_log_range), having lost most of theirs (Mars ~1%).
geochemistry._comment_beyond_ice_line_nitrogen: Bodies formed beyond the ice line accreted nitrogen as ammonia ice (the source of Titan's N2, ~80x Earth's atmosphere per unit mass): N inventory x this.
geochemistry._comment_water: Water inventory in Earth oceans (scaled by planet mass), log-normal around the inside/beyond ice line medians. Oceans exist above ocean_min_oceans; every condensable gas (not only water) uses the same column humidity profile for its condensation cap; water worlds (no exposed land) above waterworld_oceans. Vapour column mixing ratio = column_factor x relative_humidity x saturation / P (Earth: 0.4%), rising to full saturation in steam atmospheres. An ocean world absorbing more than runaway_flux (W/m2; Goldblatt et al. 2013, ~282) cannot keep liquid water: the whole ocean becomes a steam atmosphere and adds its pressure.
geochemistry._comment_outgassing: Outgassing = by_volcanism[tier] x mass factor (log-normal in mass, peaking at mass_peak_me; Ortenzi et al. 2020), plus a background for long-term accumulation. Tidal heating multiplies sulfur outgassing by 1 + flux / tidal_sulfur_flux and divides C, N and water by 1 + flux / tidal_depletion_flux (W/m2), so strongly heated moons are volatile-poor and sulfur-dominated (Io, ~2.5 W/m2).
geochemistry._comment_rainout: rainout: soluble SO2, H2S and NH3 last days on wet worlds versus ~Myr on dry ones (Earth SO2 ~ppb, Venus 150 ppm). icy_deposition: frozen ocean worlds remove them more slowly (deposition on ice, aerosols).
geochemistry._comment_weathering: Carbonate-silicate thermostat on liquid-water worlds (Walker, Hays & Kasting 1981): CO2 x min(1, at_reference^((T - frozen_K) / (reference_K - frozen_K))): no weathering at freezing, at_reference at reference_K, stronger above; water worlds x waterworld_factor (weak regulation without land). at_reference puts an Earth analogue near 400 ppm CO2.
geochemistry._comment_primordial_envelope: Chance a rocky world keeps a primordial H2/He envelope: logistic in log10(mass), 50% at half_mass_me. Only if H2/He survive escape.
geochemistry._comment_abiotic_oxygen: M-dwarf ocean worlds may build abiotic O2 from water loss during the star's bright pre-main sequence (Luger & Barnes 2015; debated, Wordsworth et al. 2018). O2 source weight 10^uniform(log_weight_range).
geochemistry._comment_climate_iterations: Composition and surface temperature are iterated to agreement. Worlds formed inside the ice line start at least at start_K (hot after formation), icy bodies at the equilibrium temperature for start_albedo; damping halves whenever a step overshoots.

atmosphere._comment_classes: Dynamo thresholds for a thick / thin atmosphere; exosphere_k sets exosphere height per class.
atmosphere._comment_mass_fraction: Giants only (rocky worlds take their pressure from the gas budget, see geochemistry). Atmosphere mass fraction: uniform giant_range + giant_mass_boost x log10(max(M, giant_mass_floor)), capped at giant_max. The rocky keys below are no longer used.
atmosphere._comment_albedo: Bond albedo = surface (rock, or ice_surface on an ocean world below ice_below_K) + rayleigh_max x (1 - exp(-P / rayleigh_scale_atm)) + water_clouds x min(1, H2O / water_cloud_ref_fraction) within water_cloud_K + sulfate_clouds x min(1, SO2 partial pressure / sulfate_ref_atm) x min(1, H2O partial pressure / sulfate_water_ref_atm) above sulfate_min_K (Venus-like columns), clamped to range; then an organic haze replaces it in proportion to the haze index (haze = Titan-like albedo). Earth ~0.30; giants fixed.
atmosphere._comment_greenhouse: Robinson & Catling (2012) gray radiative-convective model, no shortwave absorption. Each gas adds infrared optical depth ir_strength x ln(1 + sqrt(u_eff / ir_saturation_atm)), with u_eff = fraction x P x (earth_gravity / g) x (P / 1 atm)^pressure_scaling (pressure-weighted column, atm). Square root at small amounts (methane today), logarithmic at large (CO2). Surface temperature follows from the total optical depth via the model's radiative-convective boundary. Calibrated to Earth: 288 K, +1.2 K per CO2 doubling, +0.5 K for today's methane, +3 K at 1% methane, +4.5 K for doubled N2 at fixed greenhouse gases (Goldblatt et al. 2009). NH3 and SO2: early Mars, 1 bar CO2 (Jorge, Wordsworth & Adams 2024): +11.1 / +17.7 K at 10 ppm, with 1 and 100 ppm fitted to their reported ranges. Collision-induced absorption: see cia. Starlight absorbed aloft (methane, haze): see shortwave.

greenhouse._comment_n: Robinson & Catling power law tau = tau0 x (p / p0)^n inside the atmosphere. They fit Venus with n = 1 or 2; n = 1 fits Earth and Mars best here.
greenhouse._comment_pressure_scaling: Exponent m on the pressure weighting of absorber amounts (line broadening). Fit to +4.5 K for doubled N2 at fixed greenhouse gases (Goldblatt et al. 2009), after collision terms.
greenhouse._comment_lapse_rate: Robinson & Catling alpha: actual lapse rate / dry adiabat. Falls from dry to moist as the water fraction rises to moist_water_fraction (Earth ~0.004).
greenhouse._comment_giant_reference_pressure_atm: Giants have no surface, so their temperature is evaluated at this pressure level (atm), the usual 1-bar convention.
greenhouse._comment_cia: Step 3, collision-induced absorption. Each pair adds strength x x_a x x_b x P(atm) x column(Earth-gravity atm) x (share of thermal emission at the equilibrium temperature inside bands_cm, wavenumbers cm^-1). Grows with pressure squared; the band share makes far-infrared pairs matter on cold worlds. Calibration targets in each pair's note.

pairs.note: Titan greenhouse +21 K before haze (McKay et al. 1991), split evenly with CH4-N2 (the split is an estimate).
+2.5 K for 10% H2 at 1 bar N2 (Wordsworth & Pierrehumbert 2013).
280 K under 7 bar H2 at 40 W/m2 (Pierrehumbert & Gaidos 2011).
Water self-continuum: a runaway steam atmosphere of one Earth ocean (~270 atm) reaches ~1500 K (Goldblatt et al. 2013).
Half of H2-H2 (weaker per pair; Pierrehumbert & Gaidos 2011: 10% He adds <1 K).

greenhouse._comment_shortwave: Step 4. Calibration: methane alone neither warms nor cools at 10% around a 4500 K star (Ramirez & Kaltenegger 2018); methane warming peaks at CH4 = 0.1 x CO2 for a Sun-like star (Eager-Nash et al. 2023); haze max_fraction fit to Titan's 94 K. Check: CH4/CO2 = 0.3 haze cools an Archean Earth by ~17 K (Arney et al. 2016: ~20 K). Mechanism: starlight absorbed high in the atmosphere (anti-greenhouse, Robinson & Catling stellar channel absorbed at the top). Methane: methane_strength x (share of the star's light inside methane_band_um) x u_CH4 / (u_CH4 + methane_half_atm). Haze forms above onset_ratio of CH4/CO2: index = (1 - exp(-(ratio - onset_ratio) / ratio_scale)) x (1 - exp(-u_CH4 / methane_scale_atm)), absorbing max_fraction x index. Fractions combine as 1 - (1 - f_methane)(1 - f_haze).

tectonics._comment_activity: Score = dynamo x dynamo_weight + min(mass, mass_cap) x mass_weight.
tectonics._comment_plates: Count = base + int(dynamo_scale x min(dynamo, dynamo_cap)) + int(min(spin_reference_hours / max(period, min_period), spin_cap) x spin_weight) + int(mass_scale x min(mass, mass_cap)) + jitter, clamped to range. Dormant worlds divide the count.
tectonics._comment_relief: Max elevation (km) = earth_max_elevation_km x (9.81 / g). Max depth = -depth_ratio x max elevation. Dead worlds keep a fraction of both.
tectonics._comment_ocean: Water oceans need H2O, pressure above min_pressure and a temperature between 0 C and boiling (base_c + per_decade_c x log10(pressure)). Otherwise cold methane seas are possible.
tectonics._comment_inventory_coverage_k: Liquid ocean coverage = 1 - exp(-inventory_coverage_k x water inventory in Earth oceans) (Earth: one ocean, 71%). The h2o-fraction rule below is the fallback when no water state is given.
tectonics._comment_volcanic: Score = dynamo x dynamo_weight + min(mass, mass_cap) x mass_weight + tidal term (inside tidal_sma_au, up to tidal_max).
tectonics._comment_erosion: Score = min(pressure, pressure_cap) x pressure_weight + temperature bonus + ocean coverage x ocean_weight.
tectonics._comment_plate_generation: Oceanic share = ocean coverage + oceanic_offset, clamped to oceanic_range. Elevation fractions are of max depth (oceanic) or max elevation (continental). Drift speed (cm/yr) is scaled by 9.81 / g.
tectonics._comment_boundaries: Drift directions more than convergent_min_rad apart converge; less than divergent_max_rad apart diverge; between is a transform fault. Feature sizes are fractions of max elevation / depth.

moons._comment_planetary_threshold: Moons >= this mass (Me) run the full planetary pipeline (core, full atmosphere, full tectonics, full habitability).
moons._comment_placement: Moons are placed log-uniformly from roche_fraction_min x Roche limit out to hill_fraction x the parent's Hill radius. Moons inside the Roche limit become rings.
moons._comment_tidal_disruption_flux: Moons with tidal flux above this (W/m^2) are disrupted into rings. Io is ~2 W/m^2.
moons._comment_mass: Moon mass is log-uniform between parent-mass fractions (giant parents) or fractions with absolute floors (rocky parents), never below absolute_min, spanning at least min_log_span decades.
moons._comment_density_range: Bulk density clamp (g/cm^3) per moon type. Means and sigmas are in Planet_Data tidal_params.
moons._comment_small_moon_dynamo: Rocky: uniform(0, base + span x min(1, log10(max(mass, mass_floor)) + decades) / decades). Icy: uniform over icy_range.
moons._comment_tidal_atmosphere: Small moons with tidal flux >= min_flux and mass >= mass_gate get an effective dynamo of effective_dynamo when theirs is below dynamo_below (tidal outgassing).
moons._comment_eccentricity: Beta(alpha, beta) x scale; moons within proximity_roche_multiple x Roche limit skew higher.
moons._comment_volcanic_factor: Volcanic factor = slope x log10(tidal flux) + intercept, clamped to [0, max]. Io ~2 W/m^2 -> ~1.0.
moons._comment_flux_estimate: Pre-generation disruption check: representative k2, Q, eccentricity and radius exponent (R = M^radius_exponent).
moons._comment_tectonics_stub: Small-moon activity: icy = dynamo x icy_dynamo_weight + tidal x icy_tidal_weight; rocky adds min(mass, rocky_mass_cap) x rocky_mass_weight.
moons._comment_large_moon_volcanic_upgrade: Large moons with tidal factor >= this get volcanic activity bumped up one tier.
moons._comment_small_moon_ocean: Ocean coverage credited to a small icy moon with an atmosphere and a subsurface ocean.
